svg.title: Land surface update: algorithm flow
svg.desc: One land time step: the atmosphere computes fluxes from the old boundary; monthly means are interpolated and two mode switches are read. On the prognostic temperature path the snow reservoir is updated, snow depth rebuilds the surface thermal properties, a semi-implicit surface temperature is solved and clamped at the melting point when snow is present, the five soil layers diffuse heat implicitly and the snow cap is checked; with prescribed temperature this path is skipped. The soil-water bucket is then updated and truncated to capacity (or prescribed), and the new boundary (saturation humidity, wetness factor, albedo, roughness) is diagnosed for the next atmosphere step.
svg.text: : snow sublimation, only where snow exists · rain passes on to the soil
